# Eight controller and interface targets for κ ≥ 0.0035

Dugongue, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. These are proposed research questions, not asserted theorems, proof attempts, numerical tests or claims of worldwide novelty. The source scan was offline. No code from the cited packages was run.

Read `sufficiency-contract.md` first. Write K₀ = 7/2000, C★ = 9/2500, B★ = 37/10000 and t★ = 1 − C★. Each question seeks a finite effective construction uniformly for every positive legal column width f. Every full numbered target explicitly includes the still-open ordinary BIT companion at B★ and compatibility clause A, including the selected new outer predicates at κ = K₀. Its Gaussian core alone does not establish that conclusion.

For a complete supplier let Pᵣ count paid rank-r Gaussian requests and Tᵣ count independent productive rank-r Gaussian outputs, including genuinely independent helpers. Its complete target gate is

    M★(P,T) := Σᵣ Tᵣ r^t★ − Σᵣ Pᵣ r^t★ > 0.

Target credit requires actual input/output normalizers giving the specified canonical Gaussian on its own arbitrary original input. Equal rank or a coupled sum is insufficient. Paid inventories include queries, repairs, retired-helper debits and both scalar boundaries. Every question requires actual reciprocal orientations, absolute phases, owned cleanup and the native precision and compiler allowances in A.

Q64 below means the precise conservative budget in the common contract: unchanged selected-caller T and at least 1152 units of net paid-moment reduction at C★, with all changed recursive work included. A different target profile requires its own positive complete M★ and funded compiler reserves. Proximity tiers concern the Gaussian core only; B★ and the joint integration remain open in every package.

## C1. Reuse actual central observations across chronological cuts

**Tier: near-source.** Is there a finite rewrite of the selected PR5413 complete caller, retaining its standardized offers and every independent main/helper operator, that reaches Q64 by retaining and reusing actual central-query observations?

The requested object is a versioned linear program and a table of cache records. Each record identifies its actual scalar combination of current data versions, physical address frame, exact Q or Q⁻¹ observation, creation event and final read. A later use must request the same observation on the same versions and frame or pay the transformation producing the new observation. Acquisition, refresh, owned storage, restoration and all frame transports are emitted. Cached combinations receive no independent-target credit. All productive inputs remain arbitrary.

With P' the complete rewritten caller invoice, the exact requested budget is unchanged T and

    Σᵣ (Pᵣ − P'ᵣ) r^t★ ≥ 1152.

Ordinary instruction savings count only when an actually charged Gaussian request changes. The full target X_C1 is this core **and the B★ companion and A**.

**First focused question.** Which observations at adjacent actual query cuts are identical after expanding their current input versions, rather than merely having equal rank or support?

**Source distinction.** `research/p104-native-matvec-cache/README.md` supplies replay memoization, not algorithmic Gaussian reuse. `research/p104-delayed-query-side/README.md` retains its COPY invoice. `research/p104-copy-retirement/README.md` excludes deleting fixed lifetimes with that delivery chart and consumer. C1 must change the actual producer or legal reuse trajectory and price the result. It does not ask to delete those already-obstructed terms.

## C2. Complementary B/C calls with projector-valued boundary compression

Use the literal endpoints

    B = D [[1,0],[1,Q]],

Each call retains 112 independent main pairs, all 408 independent helpers and 56 exceptional ports. D acts on seven fresh axes. Physical pair permutations may move exceptional ports, preserving the independent helper bank. Backward calls use the actual corrected inverse transpose.

At each complete scalar boundary M choose actual scalar idempotents P,R and G_P(Q) = I + (Q − I)P. Emit its scalar basis maps and the complete physical boundary G_R M G_P⁻¹, using the admitted sufficient tariff rank(RM − MP). A claimed free boundary requires the actual intertwining identity RM = MP. Repeated target ranks alone are not an intertwiner.

Let n_B,n_C count calls; let Iᵣ count idle requests and Jᵣ all other paid corrections, including complete boundary tariffs. Using the literal source profiles P_B,H_B,P_C,H_C, require

    Σᵣ T_main,ᵣ r^t★ >

    + n_C Σᵣ (P_C,ᵣ − H_C,ᵣ) r^t★
    + Σᵣ (Iᵣ + Jᵣ) r^t★.

Every main target must be independently recovered. The full X_C2 includes this construction **and B★ and A**.

**First focused question.** Can both endpoint gauge projectors be transported into exact multiplicity spaces of the actual target operators, leaving small complete boundary defects?

## C6. Deferred decoding in a finite coded-service macro

**Tier: longer.** Is there a finite, explicitly closed coded-service macro using actual whole-K/E codes that yields complete M★ > 0 at C★?

Internal service endpoints may be precisely specified operators

    W₋ = Q₀⁻¹ P D,       W₊ = P D Q₀,

where P is an emitted ordinary code composed from actual stage E words and D contains the stated fresh Gaussian directions. Each service specifies all arbitrary inputs, helpers, spectators and phases. P and P⁻¹ are actual ordinary words, not free inverses of unspecified codes.

The requested macro contains at least two actual coded-service compositions before final decoding. Its fixed finite expansion has only admitted local words, canonical recursive Gaussian requests and explicitly bounded native work at the leaves. No coded oracle remains. Its root is a direct sum of independent canonical Gaussians on original inputs. Require

    Σᵣ T_root,ᵣ r^t★ > Σᵣ P_leaf,ᵣ r^t★,

including every final decoder, retired productive output and closure cost. The full X_C6 includes this macro **and B★ and A**. An infinite multitype alternative would additionally need an effective full compiler theorem for its actual service types as part of the requested result.

**First focused question.** Can two adjacent actual coded terminals compose so one final decoder serves both, with their intermediate physical codes literally matching?

## C7. A genuine Gaussian bilinear-trace consumer with reverse work charged

**Tier: longer.** Is there a finite bilinear scalar circuit whose actual derivative construction supplies independent Gaussian outputs with complete M★ > 0 at C★?

For some explicit positive integers W,m and every positive legal f, require the exact scalar output on arbitrary independent x_u,y_u to be

    B(x,y) = Σ_(u=1)^W ⟨H_(mf) x_u, y_u⟩,

using the ordinary coordinatewise bilinear pairing without conjugation. H_(mf) is the canonical rank-m Gaussian at width f with explicit spectators. Every Gaussian child and scalar/address operation is admitted; a scalar contraction has its actual finite native cost.

Supply the versioned reverse pass returning H_(mf)x_u and H_(mf)^T y_u, with actual scratch acquisition and return. P_grad counts every forward and reverse Gaussian request. H_grad counts only genuinely independent surviving helper outputs; retired or identified helpers receive no credit. Require

    2 W m^t★ + Σᵣ H_grad,ᵣ r^t★ > Σᵣ P_grad,ᵣ r^t★.

The full X_C7 includes this actual bilinear construction **and B★ and A**. An abstract automatic-differentiation principle alone does not solve it.

**First focused question.** Can actual coded producer pairs be contracted to this Gaussian bilinear form before individual decoding, with an emitted ordinary contraction and both passes fully charged?

**Source distinction.** An invariant primal/reciprocal-dual pairing can return only the original input pairing, supplying no Gaussian target. An XOR accumulator can return a single coupled sum rather than W independent outputs. The preceding `consumer.md`, dual tariffs in `boundary.md` and `Mathproof/SymplecticTITOCIBalancedCoevaluation20260901.lean` motivate C7; they do not supply its trace circuit or favorable invoice.

## C8. Sector-multiplexed queries inside an actual complete caller

**Tier: near-source.** Can complementary ordinary involution sectors share enough actual central queries in a complete selected-caller rewrite to reach Q64?

For the lifted Q retain its actual ordinary involution J = Q² and define E₊ = (I + J)/2, E₋ = (I − J)/2. Partition the actual query work into finitely many chronological sections. Each specifies a single unchanged input snapshot and a literal contribution

    (A₊ E₊ + A₋ E₋) Q x,

with actual scalar role matrices A₊,A₋. Emit their sector rank factorizations and ordinary projectors. Their admitted sufficient tariff is max(rank A₊, rank A₋). Q⁻¹ terms retain their J correction and phase. Packing combines complementary projected components, not two arbitrary full fields without a dimension account.

The rewritten caller has unchanged T and must satisfy

    Σᵣ (Pᵣ − P_sector,ᵣ) r^t★ ≥ 1152.

Include all snapshot work, section setup, intermediate updates and helper restoration. If old contributions lack this form on the same source snapshot, a changed word with its exact endpoint is required. The full X_C8 includes this core **and B★ and A**.

**First focused question.** Which actual Q/Q⁻¹ query pairs have complementary J-sector row spaces after lawful ordinary recoding of one common current source snapshot?

**Source distinction.** `typed-provider.md`, T6–T7, proves sector sharing and a strict example on its stated inputs; the example is not an admitted selected-provider instance. Unlike C1, C8 shares disjoint invariant components within a snapshot, rather than retaining one observation across time.
